card.name: Partway through names and numbers
card.fires_on: Responds to a word or number cut off partway, such as the start of a brand or drug name, a year, or a unit after a number. It is also seen at the space before a section reference like (5.7) and at labels like Effect or Examples in interaction tables.

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Start of a brand or drug name that continues in the next piece.

modes.label: Numbers and units
modes.description: A digit inside a year, or a unit right after a dose number.
modes.example: Monday, 27 August <<2>>012 Children exposed to blue

modes.label: Label text in tables
modes.description: Space before a section reference, or a heading word in a drug interaction table.
